أكتدح (form VIII)
# أَكْتَدِحُ (ʔaktadiḥu) /ʔak.ta.di.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَدَحَ (iktadaḥa)
# أَكْتَدِحَ (ʔaktadiḥa) /ʔak.ta.di.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَدَحَ (iktadaḥa)
# أَكْتَدِحْ (ʔaktadiḥ) /ʔak.ta.diħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِكْتَدَحَ (iktadaḥa)
